marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 knots diminishing to light near midnight then
increasing to south 10 to 15 early Saturday morning. Wind increasing to south 20
early Saturday afternoon and to south 25 late Saturday afternoon. Flurries ending overnight. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
